subdomains.name: Feather Subdomain (Animal)
subdomains.benefit: Gain Fly as a class skill, improve maneuverability from spells that grant a fly speed, replace Speak with Animals with Eyes of the Hawk, and replace three Animal domain spells.

powers.name: Eyes of the Hawk
powers.summary: Gain a racial bonus on Perception checks equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, and a +2 racial bonus on initiative when able to act in a surprise round.

powers.name: Animal Companion
powers.summary: Gain an animal companion using an effective druid level equal to cleric level - 3.

subdomains.name: Fur Subdomain (Animal)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Speak with Animals with Predator's Grace and replace the Animal domain's 1st- and 3rd-level spells.

powers.name: Predator's Grace
powers.summary: As a swift action, gain a scaling bonus to base speed and low-light vision for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Animal Companion
powers.summary: Gain an animal companion using an effective druid level equal to cleric level - 3.

subdomains.name: Construct Subdomain (Artifice)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Dancing Weapons with Animate Servant and replace the Artifice domain's 7th- and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Artificer's Touch
powers.summary: Cast mending at will and damage objects or constructs with a melee touch attack. Uses of the damaging touch per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Animate Servant
powers.summary: Animate objects using cleric level as caster level once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Toil Subdomain (Artifice)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Dancing Weapons with Aura of Repetition and replace the Artifice domain's 1st-, 5th-, and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Artificer's Touch
powers.summary: Cast mending at will and damage objects or constructs with a melee touch attack. Uses of the damaging touch per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Repetition
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level; enemies that fail a Will save must repeat their previous action when possible.
